correctness.rationale: The 3276 exact triple determinants in the quadratic integer ring have norm-support only 2,3,7,11, giving an unrestricted no-new-concurrence conclusion away from those primes. Exact pair cross products yield 252 double and 21 quadruple points in characteristic zero; residue-field line reductions cover all 378 pairs and the two p=2 fibers, p=3 over F9, p=7 over F7, p=11 at both roots. Independent newly implemented determinant/rational-projective and p=7/11 arithmetic reproduced the exact norm histogram, generic (252,21), p7 8+21+28, and both p11 profiles. Finite special-fiber enumeration is exhaustive on its finite field, while the norm divisibility is essential for all primes. The coefficients in RESULT and verifier match printed source equations, notwithstanding the mistaken source-table number.

final_claim: For the exact 28 Klein bitangent coefficient triples over Z[alpha]/(alpha^2+alpha+2), only residue characteristics 2,3,7,11 change geometric incidences; outside these, 252 nodes and 21 quadruples. In characteristic 7 the 28 reduced lines equal all secants of eight rational points of X^2+Y^2+Z^2=0. At each characteristic 11 prime the reduced arrangement has 84 triples and 21 quadruples; the two dyadic primes give the stated nonreduced four-line fibers.
